levels.cpr_formulas: P=(H+L+C)/3; BC=(H+L)/2; TC=2P-BC; BC/TC swapped when BC>TC
levels.period_source: daily=prior session, weekly=prior calendar week (Mon-Sun), monthly=prior calendar month; all from spot 09:15-15:29 1m bars

angel.futures_note: Token 48704 (listed as NIFTY27OCT26FUT) returns a rolled near-month-like series back to 2020-07 (basis -40..+190 pts). Its contract expires 2026-10-27; history is cached locally in data_cache.db so later runs do not need it.

field_tests.declared: 2026-10-16 by the user: 5 one-at-a-time field filters on the R1/PDH breakout variant, values taken from each condition's setup; no combinations.

predeclared_tests.declared: 2026-10-16 by the user (pasted task: re-verify C001 under the priority focus). One run each, no tuning, no combinations, report win or lose.

H-A.definition: golden_pivot_zone bullish (daily L3 inside daily CPR) / bearish (H3 inside) / none: day direction and the base-rule result per group

H-B.definition: base rule with the signal-bar close inside daily Camarilla [H3,H4] or [L4,L3] vs outside

H-C.definition: signal: the session's final 1-minute close is above the 1m 200 EMA; hit: the next session's open is strictly above that close (gap up, no threshold). Mirror: final close below the EMA followed by a gap down. Baselines: share of all session pairs that gap up / gap down. Run once, no variants, no tuning.

H-D.definition: short mirror of R001 (ATM put): close < min(PDL, S1), below futures VWAP and below 5m 20/50/200 and 1m 200 EMAs; next-open entry; exit on a 5m close above the 5m 20 EMA; force exit 15:20; one trade per day

fixed_definitions.strong_close_below_vwap: futures close below futures VWAP on a red spot candle whose body is >= 60% of its high-low range
fixed_definitions.two_strong_bullish: two consecutive 5m candles, each green with body >= 60% of range
fixed_definitions.first_green_after_reds: a green 5m candle right after >= 3 consecutive red candles (counted from the entry candle)
fixed_definitions.rejection_candle: 5m high reaches the PDH/R1 zone (>= its lower edge) and the close is below the zone
fixed_definitions.c007_staged_exit: USER ASSUMPTION: three equal parts at the first touch of the 5m 200 EMA, the weekly CPR top, the PDL/S1 zone top; a part whose level is not below the entry price uses the next stage's level; remainder at 15:20
fixed_definitions.touch: short: candle low reaches the level (fill at the level, or the open if it opened beyond); long: high reaches it

exit_test.declared: 2026-10-16 by the user: E1-E5 on unchanged version-B entries, pooled long/short; tests 31-40
exit_test.E1: 5m close back across futures VWAP against the trade
exit_test.E4: trailing stop 3 x ATR(14) Wilder 5m from best price since entry; ATR at the signal candle; intrabar
exit_test.E5: target = nearest primary level beyond entry at entry; stop = 5m close back across VWAP
exit_test.screen: PF(points) > 1.15 in both periods, layer B > 0 in both, OOS block-bootstrap 95% CI above zero
